messages:
tara: Quick note from user testing: onboarding keeps failing because people try multiple env var names for the API key. They hit a bare `401` and drop off.
mike: What variants are we seeing?
tara: REDWOOD_API_KEY, RW_TOKEN, REDWOOD_KEY, sometimes just TOKEN. Docs/samples are inconsistent.
oliver: We should pick a canonical name (REDWOOD_API_KEY) and implement graceful fallbacks in SDK for older names for a deprecation window.
mike: Agreed. SDK behavior proposal: resolution order = explicit param > REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_KEY > RW_TOKEN. Emit a single deprecation log entry per process when a legacy var is used.
tara: Also improve error text on missing auth: show human hint + link to docs instead of raw 401. Example message: "Missing API key. Set REDWOOD_API_KEY or pass apiKey to the client. Guide: https://redwood.dev/auth-env"
oliver: Rotation UX: add `rw auth rotate --env` in the CLI that updates env var and optionally hits /v1/health to validate. If validation fails revert the change and print step-by-step hints.
mike: Another bug: retry middleware currently retries on all 401s for idempotent requests. That led to loops during rotations. Fix: only retry when response includes `www-authenticate: token_expired` or body.code=="token_expired".
tara: Good. Also add a tiny `validateEnv()` snippet in sample apps so new devs can copy/paste a check that prints actionable hints.
oliver: I'll own SDK changes + tests. Mike take CLI rotate helper. Tara will file a short migration doc and support runbook. support-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-9781 "Auth env canon + rotation UX" (assignee: oliver). :white_check_mark:
tara: ETA: retry patch this week, SDK + CLI + docs in next minor. We'll run a small beta to verify reduced support tickets.
mike: Sounds good, ping for reviews.
